_comment: E1 (#223) large-graph eval set: TIL engineering-notes corpus (graph btgbx4szzfhaxcxt, 195 nodes = 180 notes + 15 category hubs, imported frozen from jbranchaud/til, MIT). The corpus comes from the live graph (use STOCK_GID=btgbx4szzfhaxcxt with eval/hybrid-ab.js or --gid with run-eval.js); this file supplies only frozen queries + graded qrels (0-3) on real node ids. Authored 2026-06-11 with content-verified grading (each graded node's text was read; sibling matches pooled by grep). Hub-membership 'related' edges (hub -> its 12 notes) exist to exercise graph expansion: hub queries (q41, q42) grade the hub 2 and every member note 1. DO NOT edit the graph or these qrels — deltas across experiments depend on both staying frozen.
